award_criteria.text: ===== FILE: files/Attachment_04._Evaluation_Factors_Questionnaire_Final.pdf ===== EVALUATION FACTORS QUESTIONNAIRE (a) The following process will be followed: (i) Evaluation: The Government will evaluate proposals using a stepped approach to identify the highest technically rated lodging BPA within the San Antonio area for JBSA. First, all received quotes will be sorted in ascending order from lowest to highest price, and only the six lowest-priced quotes will be selected for technical evaluation. These six proposals must then pass three mandatory Go/No-Go (Pass/Fail) criteria: they must be actively listed on the FEMA National Master List for Fire Safety and ADA Compliant, be located within a 15.0-mile driving radius of JBSA-Lackland or JBSA-Fort Sam Houston, and propose a daily room rate that does not exceed the maximum JTR lodging per diem for San Antonio. Any quote that fails any of these criteria is rated "Unacceptable" and immediately excluded. Next, the conforming quotes will be evaluated and ranked on a 100-point Technical Point System, which awards up to 40 points for proximity (with maximum points for facilities within 5 miles), up to 15 points for facility capacity (room block availability), and up to 45 points for mission-support amenities & Security (complimentary hot breakfast, in-room kitchenettes, base shuttle service, and interior corridor access). The award will be made to the responsible offeror with the highest total point score whose price is confirmed as fair and reasonable. If the highest-scoring offeror's price cannot be determined fair and reasonable, the Government will evaluate the next highest-scoring quote, reserving the right to expand the initial pool beyond the lowest six offers if necessary to secure an award.
